footer.tagline: imago: one account for every application on manasomali.com

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a 6-digit code. One account works in every application on manasomali.com; if you do not have one yet, it is created when you confirm the code.
login.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
login.resend_in: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
login.consent: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> (links open in a new tab).
login.account_deleted: Your account was deleted from every application. We sent a confirmation to your email.

terms_acceptance.title: New terms of use
terms_acceptance.text: The terms of use and the privacy policy of manasomali.com changed. To keep using the applications, read and accept the new version.
terms_acceptance.outdated: A newer version of the terms was published while this page was open. Reload the page to read it.
terms_acceptance.disagree: If you do not agree, you can delete your account on the <account>account page</account> without accepting.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.text: This address does not exist or has changed.

ethos.name: ethos
ethos.description: Track habits on a yearly calendar, alone or shared with other people.
ethos.deletion: the habits you own, with all their marks (guests' marks included; guests lose access and get an email about it), your participation in other people's habits, the invites you sent or received and your alerts. The marks you made in other people's habits stay in those habits, shown as by “Removed user”.
ethos.export_label: Export everything from ethos (on the report screen)
